parole.significato: to soak, to steep, to drench, to make soggy (to saturate in water or other liquid, thereby softening)
parole.testo: Inherited from Byzantine Greek *μουλιάζω (*mouliázō), from *μολιάζω (*moliázō) (with [o] → [u] change influenced by preceding labial stop [m]), from Late Latin or Vulgar Latin *molliāre (“soak”). Cognate with French mouiller.
